handbookNote: Wisconsin Real Estate Salesperson license exam. RECONSTRUCTED CONFIG: this track's original build session did not leave a local track-config/questionsDir on this machine -- the 410 live questions existed only in D1. For this pool-depth backfill pass (2026-08-31), the 410 live questions were exported directly from D1 and split by their existing 'topic' column into 23 bucket files under wi_re_salesperson_questions/ (Agency Relationships & Disclosure of Duties 16, Board Authority/Rulemaking & Committees 10, Definitions & Scope of Licensed Practice 18, Federal Antitrust Law in Real Estate Brokerage 10, Fees/Commissions & Compensation 15, Firm Structure & Supervision of Licensees 11, General Duties/Prohibited Conduct & Advertising 42, Investigation/Discipline/Penalties & Judicial Review 15, Land Use Controls & Development 14, License Issuance/Renewal/Status Changes & Firm Registration 12, Licensing Requirements & Applications 27, Out-of-State Cooperation/Multi-Party Representation & Common-Law Liability 13, Pre-License & Continuing Education Requirements 26, Property Condition & Statutory Disclosures 12, Property Valuation & Market Analysis 13, Real Estate Finance & Loan Programs 18, Real Estate Math: Calculations & Prorations 18, Real Property Ownership/Estates & Title Transfer 16, Trust Accounts & Records Retention 36, Unlicensed Assistants/Approved Forms & Legal Advice 16, WB-1/WB-4/WB-36 Listing and Buyer Agency Contract Requirements 14, WB-11 & Wisconsin Offer-to-Purchase Contract Requirements 22, Wisconsin & Federal Fair Housing Law 16) to serve as inventory/style reference for backfill agents. Regulatory framework: Wisconsin real estate licensees are regulated by the Real Estate Examining Board (REEB), part of the Department of Safety and Professional Services (DSPS) -- governing statute is Wisconsin Statutes Chapter 452 (Real Estate Practice), with implementing regulations at Wis. Admin. Code REEB 1-99 (formerly RL chapters). This track_registry entry (exam_question_count=140, pass_percent=75) reflects the current tracked exam mechanics. Note the existing bucket names reference specific Wisconsin REALTORS Association standard-form numbers (WB-1, WB-4, WB-11, WB-36) -- these are real, widely-used Wisconsin approved forms; independently verify current form numbers/content via wra.org or DSPS rather than assuming the numbering hasn't changed. Bucket agents should independently verify current exam vendor (commonly PSI), exact statute/rule section numbers, and current item counts via live fetch of docs.legis.wisconsin.gov (Wisconsin Statutes/Admin Code) and dsps.wi.gov rather than assuming. Price set at $29.99 (2999 cents) to match this project's standardized Real Estate track rate. Backfill new-question IDs use prefix 'wi_re_salesperson-deepen1-*', which will not collide with the original IDs already in D1.
